CustomField.description: Works with the Lead matching used during conversion in the Form_Submission_Convert_Upsert_Lead_Overridable flow. When matching returns multiple Lead candidates, enabling this updates the highest-confidence match instead of skipping it or creating a duplicate; leave it off to require a single unambiguous match.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When your matching rules return multiple Lead matches during conversion, update the highest-confidence match instead of skipping it or creating a duplicate. Leave it off to require a single unambiguous match before any update is made.
CustomField.label: Update Most Confident (Lead)
